reviews.quote: Orestis was very helpful and fast in repairing our tyre. The service was exceptional and seamless. Thank you!
A great guy, helpful and fast, with good prices and good tyres. He explained everything about the tyres. I recommend him 100%.
Went in after a tyre blowout. He didn't have the one we needed in stock, so he rang round six garages for us and found one. Would recommend 100%.
Very professional and fast. I'm a tourist here and he helped with our punctured car with real honesty and kindness. Grateful for his help.
Immediate service, very polite, knowledgeable and great at finding solutions.
Took care of everything quickly and at a fair price. Very gentle. Highly recommend.
Friendly, helpful and quick. Very good prices and prompt service!
Impeccable service and kind staff. Fast, polite and well priced.
